card_en: An adjective takes the gender and number of the person or thing it describes: brat je star, sestra je stara. With polite vi it takes the plural: koliko ste stari?

m.sg.note_en: Some adjectives drop an e before an ending: prijazen, prijazna.

m.du.note_en: Also for a man and a woman together.

m.pl.note_en: Also with polite vi: koliko ste stari?

quick_check.explain_en: Oče is masculine, though it ends in -e, so the adjective takes no ending: prijazen.

helper_de: A German adjective after ist never changes: er ist alt, sie ist alt. A Slovenian one always does: star, stara.
helper_en: English old stays old. In Slovenian it changes: star for him, stara for her, stari for polite vi.
